title: Entergy named a Top Utility in economic development for 19th year in a row
summary: For the 19th consecutive year, Site Selection magazine has named Entergy a Top Utility in economic development. The communities we serve continue to attract some of the nation’s most competitive and power‑intensive industries in the United States. In 2025, Entergy Texas helped secure more than $30,000 in capital investments and create more than 700 new jobs within Southeast Texas. Source

title: ITER breeding blanket and tritium plant plans advance
summary: ITER has announced progress on its tritium breeding and processing efforts, including the success of a summit bringing together the teams that are developing its tritium plant and the selection of four breeding blanket systems that will be tested at ITER.

title: Pickering refurb will “strengthen Ontario's economic sovereignty and energy security”
summary: Ontario Power Generation has begun an extensive project to refurbish the Pickering nuclear power plant. Characterized as “Canada’s largest clean energy infrastructure project,” the refurbishment will extend the operating lifetimes of the facility’s four CANDU reactors by as much as 38 years—and support Ontario’s nuclear supply chain.

title: ANS looks at Illinois’s nuclear future
summary: The latest installment in the ANS webinar series “Nuclear in the States” focused on the Society’s home state of Illinois. Illinois has 11 operating commercial reactors and the largest operating nuclear capacity in the country. Recently, it lifted the last restrictions it had on building new reactors. Furthermore, Gov. J. B. Pritzker has set a goal to add 2 GW of new nuclear capacity from either new sites or uprates, and for that construction to begin by 2033.

title: Smarter lighting can support a stronger business
summary: Lighting is one of the most visible systems in a commercial facility. It affects how customers experience a space, how employees complete their work and how safely people move through interior and exterior areas. Source

title: Entergy Louisiana President and CEO Phillip May named 2026 LABI Executive of the Year
summary: Entergy Louisiana president and CEO Phillip May has been named the 2026 Executive of the Year by the Louisiana Association of Business and Industry, recognizing his exceptional leadership in strengthening Louisiana’s business climate, advancing major economic development initiatives and supporting the wellbeing of communities across the state.
